Hi Suzanne — great to connect.

Short answer: yes. We generally run a 45–60 minute format for multi-region exec + tech pairings: 15 min exec overview, 25–30 min deep dive, 10 min Q&A. To avoid late-night windows for any party, I sketched two compact options below with UTC conversions. Please confirm which is easiest for the team.

Option A (US morning / EU midday / APAC late evening) — 45 min total - 13:00 UTC (US EDT 09:00) — EU CET 14:00 — APAC SGT 21:00
Option B (US late afternoon / EU evening / APAC morning next day) — 45 min total - 01:00 UTC (US EDT 21:00 previous day) — EU CET 02:00 — APAC SGT 09:00

Notes:
- Option B requires APAC attendees to join in their morning and US in their evening; Option A keeps US in the morning but pushes APAC late.
- We should also lock a backup 30-minute exec-only slot (10–15 minute executive overview) in case technical deep dive needs separate scheduling.

Marissa / Rishi — exec availability check: any hard constraints next Tue–Thu (Nov 5–7)? Also FYI: US DST flips on Nov 3 at 02:00 local time this week, so if we pick a slot spanning that boundary we should be careful.

I can draft a shared calendar invite with both options and an agenda. I’ll attach a short demo agenda (v2).

Thanks,
Jonas

- Slot 2: 15:30 UTC (45 min) — US: 11:30 EDT / EU: 16:30 CET / APAC: 23:30 SGT (this is late for APAC, so prefer Slot 1)
